text: Scoot Vending below Paying, since the coin slot sits above the dispensing tray. Recolour Idle to gray, because the machine is off most of the night. Hook up Paying to Vending with an arrow labeled paid, and then tell me how many connections Paying has right now. Thanks in advance.

Could you kindly place Doctor between Chief and Nurse1? I would appreciate it. Next, please change the color of Nurse2 to teal, since the new hires wear teal badges. Is there any triangle on the chart at the moment? Finally, could you confirm whether Chief is bigger than Nurse1?

Insert a hexagon called Shuffle between Data and Split, and make it gray. Then connect Shuffle to Train with a dashed arrow labeled batched, because the samples need to mix first. Let's tidy up the app flow, so make Tabbar a navy rectangle and move it below Feed. Turn Splash into a circle, and then nudge Login 25 pixels up. Which screens are not white right now? Also I want Feed to look bigger, so resize Feed.

My home network is a bit of a mess so I drew it here. Put the Router2 to the right of Modem and make the Tv a small green square. Could you connect Laptop to Router2 with a line that has no arrow? How many devices are linked to Router2 right now? Thanks, my son says you are good at this.

Okay, for my theory homework I'm mapping the chord progression. Make Dominant a red triangle and then connect Tonic to Dominant with a double arrow. Please move Subdominant above Tonic, since the diagram reads from top to bottom. Which shape is the biggest on the page?

Me and my brother are drawing a rocket! Can you make Capsule a small circle and put it on top of Stage2? Then make Fuel a huge orange rectangle, I think that is what rockets have the most of. Which shape is the topmost one now?

I am making a diagram for science class, so please connect Sun to Leaf with a dotted arrow labeled light. After that, draw an arrow from Water to Leaf, and then put Sugar to the right of Leaf. Do you know which shape is the leftmost right now? Also make Sun yellow.

Hi team, our cost map has too many lines going into Bucket, so please disconnect Worker from Bucket. Then move Bucket to the bottom right corner of the canvas, because it sits in the middle of the diagram right now. How many connections does Api have? Finally, get rid of Edge, it was a test node we never used.

For the escape room map I want the Lock to be a red diamond and it should sit between Start and Vault. Connect Lock to Exit with a dashed line, but only after the vault is open. Which shapes are not red? Could you make Exit huge?

Our building needs a clearer fire evacuation plan, so please connect Stairs1 to Exit1 with a plain arrow. Then arrange Exit1 and Exit2 in a row. Is Assembly connected to Exit2? Also move Assembly to the bottom center, since people gather there. Which shape is the bottommost one?

I run a small bakery and my tasks board is getting wild. Please move Ready between Baking and Sold, and then label Orders as Today. Make Baking orange, because it is always the busiest column. How many shapes are orange right now?

Set up the chess puzzle diagram for the class, so color Knight black and Bishop white. Put Rook above King2. Which shapes are white right now? Can you rename Rook to Castle, since that is what my students call it?

For the plot diagram, make Climax a large red star because it is the most intense part of the story. Then move Resolution to the right of Climax. Could you count how many stars there are now? Also, label Setup as Exposition.

We're planning a hike and the map needs some tidying, so put Camp between Trailhead and Summit. Connect Lake to Camp with a dotted line, because that is the water source path. What is the shortest path from Trailhead to Summit? Can you also make the Summit a tiny star?

Our quarterly goals board needs cleanup, so arrange Q1, Q2, Q3 and Q4 in a row. Make Q4 a navy box, and get rid of Q3 since we merged it into Q2. Which shapes are not navy right now? Also label Q4 as Year End.

I'm documenting a family tree for a history paper. Please move Child2 to the right of Child1, so the siblings read left to right. Could you connect Grandchild to Child2 with a dotted line? How many shapes are there in total right now? Lastly, duplicate Grandchild twice, because the family had two more grandchildren.

Okay so tickets come in as New, then get Assigned, and finally Resolved. Make Resolved a green square and place it to the right of Assigned. Which shapes are not green right now? Oh, and draw an arrow from New to Assigned labeled assign.

Insert a diamond called Check between Pack and Ship, since we need a weight check at that point in the line. Recolor Check to orange. Could you tell me the path from Pick to Ship? Also nudge Scan2 about 15 pixels down so the labels do not overlap.

We are finally redoing the backyard, so please move the Shed to the top right corner. Make the Pond blue and resize the Bench, because it looks tiny next to the others. Is the Hedge bigger than the Pond? Also which thing is closest to Pond, the Hedge or the Bench?

The agenda board for tomorrow's meeting needs fixing, so please move Talks below Demo and recolor Wrap to gold. Can you tell me the closest shape to Intro? And I think we should delete Demo, since the team already saw it last week. Thanks so much!

Please draw a line between Adenine and Thymine, no arrows, because they pair with each other. Make Guanine blue and Cytosine green. Is Adenine connected to Guanine now? Also which shape is the rightmost in the chain?

For the school play I want Actor1 to stand in front of Actor2 on stage, so move Actor1 above Actor2 on the diagram. Turn the Curtain into a large gray rectangle. What is the color of Actor2 right now? Also, could you tell me if Actor1 is smaller than Stage?

Add a diamond called Limit between Score and Approve, then connect Limit to Reject with a dashed arrow labeled over. Is Reject reachable from Apply right now? Also change the color of Score to indigo. How many connections does Approve have?

I want to show how the campaign flows, so please make Brand a huge square on the page. Connect Ads to Brand with an arrow, then connect Newsletter to Brand as well. Which shape has the most connections? Also, can you put Blogger near Ads?

Is the Battery connected to anything yet? Also rename Bulb to Lamp, because the TA calls it that. The old diagram was missing half the parts.

Let's lay out this comic page, so arrange Panel1, Panel2, Panel3 and Panel4 in a grid. Make Panel4 a huge star, no wait, make it a huge hexagon instead. Which panel is the topmost one? Then duplicate Panel2 twice for the closing pages.

For the drone route map, please move Drop above Zone2 and set Depot to a small diamond. Then add a tiny triangle called Relay, put it between Depot and Zone1, and color it cyan. Is Zone1 bigger than Zone2? How many shapes are navy right now?

Level 2 needs more coins, so please duplicate Coin five times along the Ground. Make the Goal a huge gold star and put it above the Pipe. What is the leftmost shape in the level? Oh, and recolor Pipe to green. Thanks!

Hallo, I am the group leader and we make a timeline of the project. Connect Plan to Draft with an arrow labeled write, and also connect Draft to Review2 with a dashed line. Please move Publish to the right of Review2. How many steps are finished now, meaning the shapes that are green?

Please make a flow for the soup recipe. Chop should be a blue square, and then Saute goes below it, so move Saute below Chop. Connect Saute to Simmer with a plain arrow, and label that link ten minutes. Which shapes are still not blue? Last thing, rename Serve to Plate.
Pls put Billing under Storage, since the cost lines flow down from there. Set Vm2 to red so it stands out from the rest. Is Vm1 bigger than Vm2? How many connections does Storage have?

For the festival map, please move Food to the bottom left corner, because the crowd comes in from there. Make Tent a huge purple ellipse and put it near Main. Which is the closest shape to Gate, and is Food connected to anything? Also recolor Gate to orange.

Please insert a square called Buffer right after Cutter, which means between Cutter and Welder. Then connect Buffer to Welder with a dashed arrow. Could you list every shape that is not gray? Also swap Painter and Qc so the quality check comes before painting.

The castle map is confusing, so please place Barracks between Keep and Gatehouse. Connect Moat to Keep with a dotted line, and color Moat blue. Is there a way to get from Gatehouse to Keep? I need this for my essay on medieval defense.
New hire flow: connect Hire to Badge with an arrow, then connect Badge to Laptop. Please move Welcome below Laptop and make it a teal oval. Who is linked to Badge? Also rename Laptop to Equipment.

I'm checking the data center layout for the audit, so could you move Cooler to the top right corner? After that, make Ups a huge gray square and put it below Rack. Is anything blue on the layout right now? Please also duplicate Rack four times.

Connect Red to Green with an arrow labeled timer, and connect Green to Yellow labeled timer too. Then connect Yellow back to Red. How many arrows come out of Green? Finally, make Yellow the smallest shape in the diagram.
My dog needs a schedule on this board. Please put Walk above Feed and set Groom to pink. Is Vet connected to anything right now? Also make Vet a large square, since the vet visit is important.

We have a panel at the conference, so put Panel between Speaker and Audience, and then make the Speaker a huge purple hexagon. How many shapes are on the stage at the moment? And which shape is the leftmost one for the photo? Thanks!

We're rearranging the store floor, so swap Aisle1 and Aisle2. Could you move Checkout near Entrance? Make Aisle2 blue and recolour Checkout to green. How many shapes are green right now?
